To find the total volume of concrete needed including waste:

1. **Convert all dimensions to feet:**
   * Length ($L$) = $187\text{ ft}$
   * Width ($W$) = $2\text{ ft } 7\text{ in} = 2 + \frac{7}{12}\text{ ft} \approx 2.5833\text{ ft}$
   * Depth ($D$) = $1\text{ ft } 2\text{ in} = 1 + \frac{2}{12}\text{ ft} \approx 1.1667\text{ ft}$

2. **Calculate the volume in cubic feet:**
   $$\text{Volume} = 187 \times \frac{31}{12} \times \frac{14}{12} = \frac{40,579}{72} \approx 563.60\text{ ft}^3$$

3. **Convert cubic feet to cubic yards:**
   $$\text{Volume in CY} = \frac{563.60}{27} \approx 20.87\text{ CY}$$

4. **Add 7% waste:**
   $$\text{Total Concrete} = 20.87 \times 1.07 \approx 22.34\text{ CY}$$

FINAL: 22.34 CY
